label: Luxury editorial
typography: High-contrast serif headlines (e.g. Playfair Display) over a clean grotesk body
layout: Magazine grid, oversized imagery, generous whitespace
motion: Slow fades and parallax-lite reveals (disabled under reduced motion)
audienceFit: Premium services where trust and taste sell

label: Minimalist
typography: One geometric sans (e.g. Inter) with tight hierarchy
layout: Single column, lots of air, one accent color
motion: Subtle 150ms hover and focus states only
audienceFit: Professional services and anyone who wants calm clarity

label: Playful
typography: Rounded display sans (e.g. Nunito) with chunky weights
audienceFit: Family, kids, pets and food concepts

label: Brutalist
layout: Hard borders, visible grid, no rounding

label: Retro
typography: 70s-style rounded serif (e.g. Cooper-like) with condensed sans
motion: Gentle wobble on badges, grain overlay static
audienceFit: Diners, barbers, bike shops, record and vintage shops

label: Dark premium
typography: Sharp modern sans (e.g. Satoshi/Geist) with wide tracking on labels
layout: Dark canvas, glowing accent edges, product-shot hero
motion: Smooth scroll reveals and glow on hover (reduced-motion safe)

label: Bright & friendly
typography: Friendly humanist sans (e.g. Plus Jakarta Sans)
layout: Bright hero, rounded cards, clear CTAs
audienceFit: Home services, childcare, community and local shops

label: Glass-inspired
layout: Frosted panels over soft gradient blobs
motion: Blur-in panels, slow gradient drift (static under reduced motion)

label: Earthy & natural
typography: Soft serif headings with relaxed sans body
layout: Organic shapes, natural textures, photo-led sections
audienceFit: Landscaping, wellness, plants, bakeries, community gardens

label: Industrial
typography: Condensed bold sans (e.g. Barlow Condensed) with stencil accents
layout: Heavy blocks, diagonal dividers, spec tables

label: Bold typography
typography: Huge variable-weight display type, tight leading
motion: Kinetic headline reveal (static under reduced motion)

label: High-contrast accessible
typography: Large legible sans (18px+ body), strong weight contrast
layout: Simple stacked layout, big tap targets, WCAG AAA-minded contrast
audienceFit: Seniors, care, healthcare, government-adjacent and community services

label: Warm community
typography: Warm rounded serif headings with friendly sans
layout: Story-led sections, people-first layout (illustrations, not real photos of minors)

label: Clinical calm
layout: Clean cards, plenty of whitespace, reassuring iconography
audienceFit: Dental, therapy, wellness and care providers
